needs.what: an 'ability_on_stack' target selector that filters on the ability's SOURCE object: its supertypes (Legendary), not being the activating permanent itself (exclude_self, i.e. 'another'), and not being a commander (is_commander: false) -- read from the source's last known characteristics if it has left
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_ability with new_targets and an ability_on_stack target covers 'copy target activated or triggered ability you control', but loader/targets.py `_compile_target` refuses every ability_on_stack selector key except controller, ability_kind and that_targets, and engine/targeting.py `_ability_matches` reads only those; dropping the 'another legendary source that's not a commander' clause would let it copy any ability, a much stronger card
